title: feat: add Lyria 3.5 with Google primary and fal fallback
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `google/lyria-3.5`: text-to-MP3 music through existing audio endpoints, paid-only, no aliases, no Pollinations GPU, registry provider Google. Approximate length belongs in the prompt; explicit duration and reference audio are rejected.
- Routes to Google `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions`, model `lyria-3.5`; uses the tested same-model MP3 fallback `POST https://queue.fal.run/google/lyria-3.5`, hidden as `google/lyria-3.5:fal`. Preserves fal’s reported billing units.
- Sets multiplier **1** and user price **$0.08/song** from [Google pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing#lyria-3.5). Records [fal’s $0.10 cost](https://fal.ai/models/google/lyria-3.5) separately; Pollinations absorbs the difference.
- Validates **116 focused tests**, TypeScript, and formatting. Worker tests cover both audio endpoints, forced fallback, paid/model permissions, one wallet debit, one billed event payload, and cache retrieval with mocked upstreams. Direct probes returned valid MP3s: Google ~19s; two fal requests ~35s with reconciled $0.10 charges. Local catalog shows $0.08.
- **Draft gates:** Google billing export reconciliation; authenticated live E2E (existing local token/database mismatch), disconnect/rejoin, live analytics, and quota/burst validation. No new secret: `GEMINI_API_KEY` is already configured for staging and production in #15499 (shared with Gemini 3.8 TTS, #15395). No deployment.

Addresses #15259. Quest-Pollen access remains outside this paid-only contract.

gist.headline: A new song in the hive
gist.blurb: Lyria 3.5 is wired up for text-to-MP3 music. Give it a prompt, including an approximate length, and the existing audio API can handle the rest once the launch checks are done.
gist.summary: Added paid-only `google/lyria-3.5` to the existing audio endpoints at $0.08 per song, using Google as the primary provider and a same-model fal fallback; live billing and deployment checks remain open.
gist.impact: Once deployed, paid users can request MP3 songs through the audio API by describing the music and approximate length in the prompt; explicit duration and reference audio are not supported.
